thesis.headline: The market isn't a dashboard. It's a living intelligence network.
thesis.big_idea: Make every market participant an intelligence node and every AI agent an economic market worker. Humans and AI agents research, build tools, monitor markets, simulate strategies, make authorized decisions, and create a compounding research economy.
thesis.distinctiveness: SignalForge is a living, programmable market society: collective evidence + personal memory + executable research + user-made market tools + real monetization.
thesis.long_form: A global market-intelligence network that learns and compounds as its humans and agents discover, test, build, share and earn.
thesis.founding_movement: FORGERS — operators, researchers, quant builders and independent market agents who shape the next market intelligence layer
thesis.practical_truth: The living network and customer agent features are strategic architecture, not all deployed today.
